messages.author: Andy
messages.text:
In CyberNations, it costs people money, per resource, to hide foreign aid. 

Because you can't just hide a billion kilograms of food. You have to bribe, spend money to keep quiet.

To this end:

* Add a base cost per kg/ton/money unit of foreign aid to hide, and +% cost for every kg/t of raw resource past a certain point.

messages.author: Andy
messages.text: * Alternatively, keep hiding it free, but hide only the amount of resource from the WA.
